pool.text: The city was founded by Abu Bakr ibn Umar as the capital.
Abd al-Mu'min captured Marrakesh after a siege of several months.
Abd al-Mu'min founded the Kutubiyya Mosque next to the former palace.
Abd al-Mu'min was responsible for establishing the Menara Gardens.
Marrakesh was conquered by the Marinids, a Zenata tribe.
The Ben Youssef Madrasa was constructed by the Saadian Sultan Abdallah al-Ghalib as Morocco's largest madrasa.
A protocol giving independence to Morocco was signed.
The Ben Youssef Madrasa building was refurbished and reopened to the public as a historical site.
UNESCO declared the old town area a World Heritage Site.
The Marrakesh Agreement was signed here to establish the World Trade Organisation.
The International Film Festival of Marrakech was established.
The Moroccan government signed a loan agreement worth eight million U.S. in February.
The Marrakech Bienniale was established by Vanessa Branson as a multidisciplinary cultural festival.
King Mohammed VI inaugurated the road from Marrakesh to Settat in April.
Fatima-Zahra Mansouri was elected the first female mayor of the city.
The House of Photography of Marrakech was opened by Patrick Menac’h and Hamid Mergani.
King Mohammed VI inaugurated a regional psychiatric hospital in Marrakesh built by the foundation.
A major gas explosion occurred in the city.
A bomb attack took place in the Jemaa el-Fnaa square, killing 15 people.
The city hosted the United Nations Climate Change Conference.
